The '''Steamfields''' was a geologically active region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]].

==Description==
The Steamfields was the site of various hot springs, [[Geyser/Legends|geysers]] and natural vents. A number of [[Species/Legends|species]] of fungus grew around the edges of the pools within the Steamfields and they emitted phosphorescent light. At the center of the region, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] descendents of the crew of the crashed [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Dying Sun]]'' constructed an altar.
